1.

the learned AGA for the State and perused the records.

2. The instant application has been filed seeking release of the applicant on bail in Case Crime No.
667 of 2022, under Sections 409, 420 IPC, Police Station Kotwali Nagar, District Barabanki.
3.

5.

sentences.text: The learned counsel for the applicant has submitted that the applicant has been granted bail in two other cases of similar nature, namely, Case Crime Nos. 978 of 2021 and 645 of 2022, Police Station Kotwali Nagar, Barabanki, by means of orders dated 18.09.2023 passed by this Court in Criminal Misc. Bail Application Nos. 11202 of 2023 and 11204 of 2023 respectively.

entities.text: Case Crime Nos. 978 of 2021 and 645 of 2022
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

entities.text: Criminal Misc. Bail Application Nos. 11202 of 2023 and 11204 of 2023
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text: 6. Having considered the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case and keeping in view the fact that the applicant has already been granted bail in two other cases of similar nature and that she is languishing in jail since 21.11.2022, I am of the view that the applicant is entitled to be released on bail in the present case.
7. Accordingly, this bail application stands allowed.

8. Let the applicant-Gunjan Verma be released on bail in Case Crime No. 667 of 2022, under Sections 409, 420 IPC, Police Station Kotwali Nagar, District Barabanki on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of magistrate/court concerned,
subject to following conditions:-
(i) the applicant shall not tamper with the prosecution evidence;
(ii) the applicant shall not pressurize the prosecution witnesses;
(iii) the applicant shall appear on each and every date fixed by the trial court.
Order Date :- 18.9.2023 Pradeep/-
